spans.s:
mfn. (-डः-डा-डं)
1 Cold, frigid, chilly.
2 Stupid, apathetic, idiotic.
3 Dumb.
n. (-डं)
1 Water: see जल.
2 Lead.
f. (-डा)
Cowach.
m. (-डः)
1 Cold, frost, winter.
2 Idiocy, fatuity, stupidity.
3 Dulness, apathy, sluggishness of mind or body.
E.
जल to heap or accumulate, affix अच्, and ल changed to ड.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Dilatory, working slowly.
E.
जड apathetic, and क्रिया business, affix ड.

f. (-ता)
1 Coldness, chilliness.
2 Apathy, stupidity.
3 Stupefaction, despair.
E.
जड, as above, and तल् affix of the abstract; also with त्व, जडत्वं.

m. (-मा)
1 Stupefaction, insensibility.
2 Stupidity, dulness.
3 Frigidity.
E.
जड cold, &c. इमनिच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Paralysed, rendered cold, torpid or insensible, confounded.
E.
जड, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stupefied, paralysed, become torpid, dull, or insensible.
E.
जड, and भूत been, च्चि aug.

m. (-लः)
A freckle, a mark.
E.
जल to accumulate, उलच् affix, and ल changed to ड.

n. (-ड्यं)
1 Coldness, apathy.
2 Folly, stupidity, dulness or coldness of intellect.
3 Coldness, frigidity.
E.
जड cold, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
